critical_code_review_comments: Note: Both time slots default to current time when confirmed via DateTimePicker without changing the time. This means if user adds 2 slots quickly, they may both show same time (e.g., '12:10, 12:10'). This is expected UX behavior (user can edit each slot), not a bug.

The fullPreviewModal in StepPreview only shows 'Créneaux horaires' section when recurringTimes.length > 1. For single time slot, the time is only shown in the infoCard schedule row. This is acceptable.
Backend model comment still says { type: 'weekly', day: 0-6, time: 'HH:MM' } (old format) but accepts any dict — minor doc improvement needed.
